title: Convert a Node project from CommonJS to ES modules
prompt: Convert this whole Node project from CommonJS to native ES modules: set "type": "module" in package.json, and replace every require()/module.exports/exports.x in src/ and test/ with import/export (remember relative imports need the .js extension). Keep the public API of src/index.js the same (TaskList, formatTask, resetIds), and keep `npm test` passing.
